name: frame_wide
prompt:
A slot-game board frame on a fully transparent background: a wide rectangular border made of chunky cartoon log wood (warm brown logs with darker grain lines, round log ends at the four corners), a thick pile of white snow draped along the top edge with a few icicles hanging down, a small green cannabis leaf and a pinecone tucked in the top corners. The border is fairly thin (the side bands about 4% of the width, the top band a little taller with the snow) and the WHOLE inside of the rectangle is empty and fully transparent - nothing drawn inside the frame. The frame fills the picture edge to edge.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
